goal: Report the reference of the standing order paid on day 08 for member 40055
description: Looked up member 40055, opened Standing Orders, found the order with Day 08: Reference SO-5501 (Payee AQUA UTILITIES, Amount 18.00, Day 08). Returned order_ref = SO-5501.

params.name: member_no
params.description: supplied by the caller per invocation

params.name: day
params.description: supplied by the caller per invocation

locator.why: Read the reference of the standing order row matching day 08

steps.intent: Initial visit to observe the application
Enter operator id to sign on
Enter pass code to sign on
Navigate to member lookup to find member 40055

target.why: Navigate to member lookup to find member 40055

steps.intent: Enter member number to look up

target.why: Enter member number to look up

steps.intent: Navigate to standing orders to find the order paid on day 08

target.why: Navigate to standing orders to find the order paid on day 08

steps.intent: Read the reference of the standing order row matching day 08

target.why: Read the reference of the standing order row matching day 08

success_template:
# frame: navFrame
- table:
  - rowgroup:
    - row "MERIDIAN":
      - cell "MERIDIAN"
    - row "Main Menu":
      - cell "Main Menu":
        - link "Main Menu":
          - /url: /menu
          - img "Main Menu"
    - row "Member Inquiry":
      - cell "Member Inquiry":
        - link "Member Inquiry":
          - /url: /lookup
          - img "Member Inquiry"
    - row "Sign Off":
      - cell "Sign Off":
        - link "Sign Off":
          - /url: /content
          - img "Sign Off"
# frame: workFrame
- table:
  - rowgroup:
    - row "MERIDIAN CORE 4.2":
      - cell "MERIDIAN CORE 4.2":
        - table:
          - rowgroup:
            - row "MERIDIAN CORE 4.2":
              - cell "MERIDIAN CORE 4.2"
- table:
  - rowgroup:
    - 'row "STANDING ORDERS Reference Payee Amount Day Status {out} AQUA UTILITIES 18.00 {day} CANCELLED Active orders: 0 New Order Cancel Ref. Cancel Order"':
      - 'cell "STANDING ORDERS Reference Payee Amount Day Status {out} AQUA UTILITIES 18.00 {day} CANCELLED Active orders: 0 New Order Cancel Ref. Cancel Order"':
        - text: STANDING ORDERS
        - table:
          - rowgroup:
            - 'row "Reference Payee Amount Day Status {out} AQUA UTILITIES 18.00 {day} CANCELLED Active orders: 0"':
              - 'cell "Reference Payee Amount Day Status {out} AQUA UTILITIES 18.00 {day} CANCELLED Active orders: 0"':
                - table:
                  - rowgroup:
                    - 'row "Reference Payee Amount Day Status {out} AQUA UTILITIES 18.00 {day} CANCELLED Active orders: 0"':
                      - 'cell "Reference Payee Amount Day Status {out} AQUA UTILITIES 18.00 {day} CANCELLED Active orders: 0"':
                        - table:
                          - rowgroup:
                            - row "Reference Payee Amount Day Status":
                              - cell "Reference"
                              - cell "Payee"
                              - cell "Amount"
                              - cell "Day"
                              - cell "Status"
                            - row "{out} AQUA UTILITIES 18.00 {day} CANCELLED":
                              - cell "{out}"
                              - cell "AQUA UTILITIES"
                              - cell "18.00"
                              - cell "{day}"
                              - cell "CANCELLED"
                        - text: "Active orders: 0"
        - link "New Order":
          - /url: /neworder?no={member_no}
          - img "New Order"
        - table:
          - rowgroup:
            - row "Cancel Ref.":
              - cell "Cancel Ref."
              - cell:
                - textbox
            - row "Cancel Order":
              - cell
              - cell "Cancel Order":
                - button "Cancel Order"
